user.title: Home Assistant WeChat Control
user.description: A pairing QR code will be generated after you submit. This integration encrypts Home Assistant entity data and sends it to the author's relay server for forwarding; the server only forwards data and does not store or analyze it. If you are not comfortable with this, please stop using this project.

expired.title: QR code expired
expired.description: No scan within {window} seconds. Submit to generate a new QR code.

init.title: Devices and entities
init.description: The relay address is built in. Set an include scope by domain or entity, then remove items with the exclude lists. exclude_entities wins; include_entities can override exclude_domains. Leave a list empty to disable that filter. Select paired devices to remove them; they must pair again.
